evidence.title: Village Board making sure data centers aren't coming to Baldwin
evidence.supports: Confirms Village President Lance Van Damme's proposal for a one-year data-center moratorium and that the Village Board approved drafting an ordinance at its May 13, 2026 meeting (article text was ROT47-obfuscated in the page source; decoded with a standard ROT47 pass per the research-process notes on Lee Enterprises/BLOX CMS sites).

decisions.notes: The key troubleshooting finding here: the Baldwin Bulletin article that the original researcher marked as 'paywalled even under a browser-mode fetch and returned no article text' actually saves successfully under save_source.py's default http mode, with the article body present but ROT47-obfuscated (the exact Lee Enterprises/BLOX CMS pattern flagged in work/research-process.md's 'Lessons from the pilot agents').
